details: Package name suggests a desktop setup helper for ChatGPT, which could resemble a brand-impersonation lookalike. However, no install-time lifecycle scripts, no network fetch-and-execute, no credential or environment reads, no silent-relay, and no backdoor behavior are present in the shipped files. With only four files scanned and no concrete malicious code paths observable, there is no demonstrable attacker benefit against an installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
